# Tags-recommender-system-for-community-forums

> NLP multi-label tag recommender for community forums (Stack Overflow, Stack Exchange, Discourse, Codechef). Combines TF-IDF with neural networks and an active learning loop for iterative improvement.

Tags-recommender-system-for-community-forums solves the multi-label classification problem for community forum posts. Unlike single-label NLP tutorials, real forum posts span multiple tags: a post about "webscraping using python and Selenium" needs three tags (webscraping, python, selenium). This project builds a tag recommender that predicts relevant tags from post text using TF-IDF features fed into neural networks, with an active learning loop that surfaces uncertain predictions for human annotation.

## Results

- F1 Score: 0.45
- Accuracy: 0.96 on scraped Stack Overflow / Stack Exchange dataset

## Approach

1. Web-scrape tags and topics from Stack Exchange and Stack Overflow
2. Frame as multi-label classification (one post can have many tags)
3. TF-IDF vectorization of post text
4. Neural network classifier with sigmoid output for multi-label
5. Active learning loop: model surfaces low-confidence predictions for human review
6. Streamlit deployment for interactive tag prediction
7. AWS migration for production hosting

## Key files

- Tag_recommender.ipynb: main notebook with TF-IDF and neural network tag recommender
- Sai's_code_Tag_Annotation_Deep_Learning_TF_IDF_approach.ipynb: deep learning TF-IDF approach with active learning integration
- webscraping_stack4.xlsx: scraped dataset from Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange
- demo-C.gif: demo of the Streamlit tag recommender app
- final presentation.pptx: project presentation

## Tech stack

- Python, TF-IDF (scikit-learn), Neural Networks (Keras/TensorFlow)
- Active Learning (modAL or custom uncertainty sampling)
- Streamlit (deployment)
- AWS (production migration)
- Google Colab (notebook runtime)

## Dataset

- Scraped from Stack Overflow and Stack Exchange: post text and associated tags
- Stored in webscraping_stack4.xlsx

## Example

Post: "How to do webscraping using python and Selenium?"
Predicted tags: webscraping, python, selenium
